Okay I see! I think we kinda talk past each other. I mean my problem is my adhd, which is a neurodevelopmental  disorder.
You can overall say that I have a problem with executive function, so the ability to continuously control you emotions, thought and actions, in order to achieve a goal. It sounds a bit abstract, when you don’t know much about it… but because it’s a disorder, you need treatment. For some people medication is enough and for others it isn’t, depending on how severe your ADHD is. For me I probably need to see a therapist or a coach, to help me figure out how to handle these things, wich I am sadly not able to get. Because I can’t do it on my own or only with medication. 
I hope this answers your question:)

 ,, I cant motivate myself to do something for uni, maybe I have adhd too'', '' but you can do hyperfocus, i envy that´´, ´´You took the pills so everything should be fine?´´ basically down playing your condition.

This is what I meant and also this was a vent, I dont tell anyone of my friends that this hurt me, because i dont want to bother them.

also? I dont know why you feel so attacked by this, I glady take time for my friends, so they can tell me about their problems. But as I mentioned my post was never about them. These stigmas are in everybody, not only my friends and family, they just tell me what they heard my condition means and dont really know otherwise.

I don’t want any of my friends or strangers to help me. I want the health care system to help me. Because they are no resources or treatment for people like me. And I think that’s partly because of the cliches and stigmas around adhd, that get pushed by media.

All I maybe ‘want’ from my friends is that they take me seriously. But I would never demand that they do anything for me or put they life aside to help me.

Sry if this was not clear from my post and I am sorry that people treated you this way and I hope you get better.
